_doc: Adventure mode content (src/adventure/data.rs). Monsters: hp, attack (max melee damage before armour), defense (to be hit), armor (soaks damage), speed (100 = a man walking), xp. 'look' is a beast name for tiles::beasts::of_name or 'folk:RACE:HELM:ARM' for a person. 'ai': melee | ranged | caster | coward | slow. Habitats are site kinds; 'tier' 1-6 sets how deep or far it is met. Loot: item id, chance in 1000, count range. Items: slot, kind, attack/defense/armor, value in gold, glyph. Materials scale weapons (att) and armour (arm); quality as DF's: ordinary .. masterwork.
